propositions: Eval/calibration library excludes activated project code-review criteria; _code_review_prompt_id admits only static built-in ids without repository context
calibrate_criterion maps non-physical ids through default plan-review namespace and lacks code-review membership branch
_code_review_prompt_id must accept optional repo_root parameter and admit logical ids from code_review.registry.effective_criteria mapped via criterion_prompt_id with gate_key="code_review"

calibrate_criterion must route to code-review arm only when repo_root is provided and criterion_id is in effective_criteria, resolving via criterion_prompt_id; plan-review callers and repo-root-absent cases retain current behavior
EvalError from load_eval_spec in code-review arm must be re-raised with located context including the logical criterion_id and original path/message
